title: Annotatio IV §.XIX: Taborite confession 1432 — whole Jesus spiritually; bread and wine substance remains
pass_a_gloss: Which words also make the first article of the Taborites’ Confession on the presence and adoration of Christ in the Sacrament, published in the year 1432… Compare the Taborites’ Response to the articles of the Prague Synod…: Therefore, they say, we say that according to Holy Scripture’s sentence and the holy doctors’ documents it is to be believed Catholically and confessed with most sincere mouth that the whole Jesus and His true body and blood are in the sacrament of the altar truly, sacramentally and SPIRITUALLY, the substance of true bread and wine remaining, not however with all Essential and accidental properties following that same body.
pass_b_english: Those words also form article 1 of the 1432 Taborite Confession on presence and adoration.

Response to the Prague Synod: believe and confess the whole Jesus — true body and blood — in the altar sacrament truly, sacramentally, SPIRITUALLY, bread and wine substance remaining, without all following properties of the body in heaven.
source_text: Quæ verba etiam articulum primum Confessionis Taboritarum de præsentia & adoratione Christi in Sacramento, editæ anno 1432, conficiunt… Confer Resp. Taboritarum ad articulos Synodi Pragensis…: Idcirco, inquiunt, dicimus, quòd secundum Scripturæ Sacræ sententiam, sanctorum documenta doctorum, Catholicè est credendum, ore sincerissimè confitendum, totum Jesum ejusque verum corpus & sanguinem in sacramento altaris esse veraciter, sacramentaliter ac SPIRITUALITER, veri panis ac vini remanente substantiâ, non autem cum omnibus proprietatibus, tam Essentialibus, quàm accidentalibus, consequentibus idem ipsum corpus.
